commercialStanding.recognition: A recorded conversation at the bank, freight office, warehouse or commons

exchange.privateLegalCargo: Unbooked legal cargo-factor asks are at least the current ordinary local bid plus1cr; restricted fixed-price merchandise and already signed quest terms are unchanged.

directions.buy: Player buys from station; a producing station always lists its output, subject to stock and player requirements.
directions.sell: Player sells to station; a consuming station accepts owned goods, even if it does not retail them.

exchange.compositeCostFloor: Targeted acyclic textiles, refined alloy, filters and magnesium floors cover dated generic ingredient asks plus normal metered processing services, including half-lot rounding. Essential water/gas/mineral treatment receives explicitly metered station support for any shortfall; reversible utility chemistry is not forced into recursive price floors.
exchange.stock: Daily input- and output-storage-constrained production minus final use and factory inputs, plus sourced, capacity-limited delayed freight. Per station/product stores hold 125% of peak planned seasonal inventory, at least 100 lots. Production tapers above 90% utilization including committed inbound cargo; every coproduct must fit. Imports reserve room; full stores defer unloading without losing cargo. Sales are capped to physical free room and a finite funded daily allowance based on local use and exports. Retired exchange supply agreements reserve no stock or buying allowance. Daily retail and buyer allowances track net stock movement: returned cargo replenishes same-day sale availability, and buying back a sale releases its buyer allowance. Gross receipts stay recorded; a round trip cannot enlarge the original net allowance. Working inputs and life-support reserves remain protected. Retail allocations are limited separately from conserved physical stores. Historical excess is worked down, never silently discarded; no independent reserve reset. Operating reserves = max(80, (mean consumption times min(30, lead days) + mean production times5) times inventory scale); these guide commercial needs, not the curve midpoint. Price center and half-width = storage capacity /2. Fill = clamp(physical stock / capacity, 0, 1). Weight = (1 + tanh(2 times (1 - 2 times fill)) / tanh(2)) /2. Price factor = exp(-.085) + (exp(.085) - exp(-.085)) times weight. The curve is symmetric and inflects at 50% full, where its price is the arithmetic mean of the old upper and lower limits. Logistics are a small overlay; seasonal stock is not added twice. Accounting lots contain250kg net material; product-specific container tare and packed volume use each ship’s gross-tonne and cubic-metre limits. Recipes and prices remain per net lot. Marginal half-lot prices clear every order on the same curve. Public catalogue snapshots exclude player stock perturbations.

freight.deadlines: Unaccepted deadline = dispatch cycle start + loaded reference-route flight and clearance at that issue date + 90 days, capped by the simulation calendar. Board reads never extend it. Hide an offer when current day + actual loaded fleet flight and clearance exceeds that deadline; recheck at acceptance before cargo/stock changes. Arrival exactly on the due date is allowed. A new dispatch cycle uses a new id. Signed jobs retain their deadline; calendar advances, including in-transit days and incident delays, fail the job once when day > deadline; survivors remain sealed client returns.
freight.fee: Source acquisition reference = source station bid; receiving invoice reference = destination station ask, summed over all products. Reference operating budget excludes cargo acquisition, flat service profit and noncash capital. Profit pool = max(0, receiving invoice - source acquisition - operating budget). Share = min(.25, (.08 + .10*risk + .04*urgency + .02*min(1,days/180) + .01*(products-1)/3)*existing support/captain multiplier). Commission = floor(pool*share/(1+share)); station retained profit = pool - commission. Commission <= floor(.25*station retained profit). Actual payment = commission + accrued eligible voyage expenses, capped at the reference operating budget. Each departure cost is divided by gross packaged cargo mass across all cargo aboard; no duplicated reimbursement or payment for nonexistent travel. Commercial offers require a positive profit pool. Cargo replacement value only sets missing/theft liability, not the profit share
freight.risk: Navigation and freight share actual combined voyage probability: 1-(1-corridor)*(1-approach), capped at .55 ordinarily; confirmed projected destination blockade is 1 for pricing. Corridor uses origin, duration, belt and regional exposure; approach uses the destination. Dated thirty-day public background reports adjust the forecast with 30 prior arrivals and fade over 120 days. Personal creditor exposure and confirmed intelligence may affect the voyage. Public circulars describe neutral station approaches. Either, both or neither raid can occur. Accepted commissions, expense ceilings and liabilities remain signed. Recorded expense reimbursement is earned only on travel.
freight.source: Finite local exchange stock is removed at acceptance; receiving clients consume delivery without adding destination resale stock. At most six distinct destinations, one shipment per destination. Source stock above a protected consumption reserve is matched to receiving deficit and thirty days of net use, less inbound client cargo and demand credits. Active same-origin routes remain reserved across refreshes; each route/cycle can be booked once.

registry.reservations: One unpaid reservation at a qualified supplier for the next finite class batch. Catalogue price due on collection; cancellation has no payment or reward.

blockades.lifecycle: Deterministic finite 21–45-day station episodes within 180-day slots, followed by patrol relief. Earth corridor protected for the charter’s first 365 days; player liberation suppresses outbreaks starting within 90 days. Legacy recorded sieges receive bounded 60-day relief. Accepted commissions remain unpaid and open-ended after NPC relief, and acceptance never creates an arrival encounter. Arrival forces combat before docking. Failed attempts allow retry or billed fleet recovery away. Legal exchange recovery sell premiums last 30 days; baseline buy and generic price distributions stay unchanged.
